short_bio: Jamaican sprinter who holds the world records in the 100 m and 200 m.
biography:
Usain Bolt was born in Sherwood Content, in Trelawny Parish, Jamaica. He won the 200 m at the World Junior Championships in 2002 at age 15.

At the 2009 World Championships in Berlin he set the world records that still stand: 9.58 seconds for 100 m and 19.19 for 200 m. He won the 100 m, 200 m and 4×100 m relay at the Olympic Games of 2008, 2012 and 2016, though the 2008 relay medal was later stripped because a teammate was found to have doped.

He retired after the 2017 World Championships in London.
